title: 12 Crayon Babies Songs! 🎵 Learn & Sing with Baby Jimmy & Baby Ava | Nursery Rhymes for Toddlers
description:
12 happy sing-along songs in one video! 🎵 Count, learn shapes, say A for apple, moo with the farm animals and practise good habits with Baby Jimmy and Baby Ava – over 6 minutes of learning fun for toddlers and preschoolers.

🎬 What happens in this video:
🧱 Jimmy and Ava's block tower falls down – let's count to five and build it again!
🔺 Circle, square, triangle – Jimmy finds shapes in his snacks
🍎 A is for apple, A is for ant – learn the letter A in the park
🐮 Moo, baa, cluck – sing the farm animal sounds
🐶 A sad puppy, a falling leaf, a little seed that grows
🦷 Brush your teeth, tidy up, say please and thank you, and "Hot, hot – don't touch!"
🎃 The sad pumpkin gets a big smile

📚 Kids learn: counting 1 to 5 • shapes (circle, square, triangle) • the letter A • farm animal sounds • nature words (seed, leaves, grow) • brushing teeth • tidying up • please and thank you • hot-don't-touch safety • kindness and sharing a smile

🎶 Voices only: children singing, humming and clapping with a soft hand drum – no other musical instruments.

A fun nursery rhyme compilation for toddlers and preschoolers (ages 1–5) with Baby Jimmy and Baby Ava: learning songs about numbers, shapes, letters and animals, plus good-habit songs for everyday routines. Sing, clap and learn along!

Kids songs • Nursery rhymes • Learning songs for toddlers • Good habits for kids • Learn English for kids • Preschool learning • Kids cartoon • Sing-along songs
